name: Kortexify
description: Kortexify is a local-first, AI-augmented academic workspace designed to replace fragmented study tools (Anki, Quizlet, Chegg, and unanchored chat interfaces like ChatGPT). By combining zero-latency offline storage, multimodal STEM OCR, local vector retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and adaptive spaced repetition, Kortexify transforms unstructured academic materials into an active-recall mastery system in a single document drop.
